events.title: Pure syntactic Shannon/hash-cons quotient route closed on equality family
formal_statement: For EQ_n(X,Y)=AND_i(x_i<->y_i), X-first Shannon existential projection with only structural hash-consing/local simplifications materializes at least 2^n distinct Y-prefix/minterm branch structures in cumulative DAG history.
After all variables are projected the final live DAG can nevertheless be constant TRUE.
PF1 eliminates each equality pivot prebirth because the two residual sides are y and NOT y, whose disjunction is TRUE.

events.title: Known knowledge-compilation languages audited as universal boundary containers
result: Bova-Capelli-Mengel-Slivovsky expander graph-CNF theorem gives DNNF size 2^Omega(n) for a class of sparse CNFs.
Therefore universal exact polynomial boundary compilation into DNNF is refuted.
Literal DNNF subclasses inherit this size barrier on the source family.
OBDD/structured-DNNF width barriers and BDD/ZDD operation blow-ups are preserved only in their source representation scopes.
No DNNF/OBDD/ZDD lower bound is promoted to an arbitrary unrestricted B2-circuit lower bound.
events.new_tension: Restricted tractable query languages can have exponential representation size; unrestricted circuits restore hard equivalence/quotient discovery.

events.title: ER-certified rewrite lane identified with existing Extended Resolution frontier
formal_statement: A rewrite sequence whose logical certificates consist only of frozen B2 extensions plus Resolution/local identities compiled to B2/Resolution fragments concatenates into one B2 proof with polynomial overhead.
By existing B2/ER p-equivalence, universal polynomial total rewrite-certificate size implies ER p-boundedness.
Deterministic polynomial rewrite discovery is still the separate C2/#215 automatability/discovery obligation.
events.meaning: Calling a trace rewrite/quotient does not bypass ER if its proof authority compiles to ER. PF1/orbit/live-width are useful candidate generators/controllers, not automatic new proof power.
